They told me they were going to take me to jail or a rehab center.  I was like 'I am NOT FUCKED UP!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!' a cop drove by and I decided to prove my point. (xanax impairs the fuck out of my decision making skills.) I got out of the car and walked up to the cop.  I said, 'hey how the fucks it going!
I got out of the car and walked up to the cop.  I said, 'hey how the fucks it going!
My parents think I am intoxicated but I am not, and so I just wanted to prove it to them. They said I looked fucked out of my mind and they gave me numerous sobriety tests, I failed every fucking one.
Then they found the bag of a 100 xanax. I told them I had a prescription for them, (which is true) they didnt believe me so they hauled me straight to jail for the night.  I dont remember anything after this except that I dropped the pisscup in the toilet and then gave it to them.  The cops kept asking me if I was robo frying.  Well, the next day I went to court and they could not do shit to me because I had a script.
